s: Din hattebalin beyom tob ubo t' seipim: dakin et hattebalin bemakteshet kedarkan, veen tzarik laasot shum shinnuy, kevan shei epshar lo laasot "meleket okel nepesh" zo beereb yom tob belo hepsed vechesron taam, shehare im yaduk otam meereb yom tob yapigu taman. Vehu haddin kol hanniddokin hammepigin taman, kegon shum veshachalayim upilpelin. Abal asur laduk beyom tob dabar sheeno mepig taam im haya niddok meereb yom tob, kegon melach vekarkom, ella im ken hitta hammakteshet al tzidda bishat dika, o sheyyaduk biqara, kede sheyyeshanneh midderek haddika bechol veyihyeh nikkar shehayyom hu yom tob, velo yabou lezalzel bo bishar melakot. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim daapillu tebalin hammepigin taman asur ledukan kedarkan beyom tob belo shum shinnuy, shemmechamat qilqul taam muat shehaya mitqalqel im haya niddak meereb yom tob — en anu mattirim lo laasot melaka gemura beyom tob, ella im ken lo yada beereb yom tob im yitztarek kelal litbalin beyom tob, dehaynu shello yada ezeh min tabshil yebashshel lemachar, sheen kol [ha]tabshilin tzerikim tebalin. Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem.

Vaapillu im lo yada beereb yom tob im yitztarek litbalin beyom tob — nohagin lehachamir leshannot qetzat bedikatan, kede shemmittok kak yihyu zekurin sheasur laduk yoter mimmah shetztzarik leyom tob. Veken rauy lehorot lahamon am, sheenan yodein lechalleq ben yada meetmol sheyyitztarek litbalin lemachar leshello yada im yitztarek.

Umuttar leholik tebalin o madok etzel meduka o meduka etzel tebalin umaduk, veen chosheshin shemma yimmalek velo yaduk, venimtza tarach beyom tob shello letzorek. Vaapillu derek reshut harabbim muttar leholikam ap al pi shehaya epshar leholikam meereb yom tob, lepi shello gazeru al hotzaa shehaya epshar laasotah meereb yom tob, mittaam shennitbaer besimman ttz"h.

Vekol zeh bimduka, abal asur lishchoq et happilpelin veet hachardal berechayim qetannim shellahem apillu shochaqan echad echad, kevan shedderek lishchoq harbeh beyachad beyom echad letzorek yamim rabbim — hare zeh domeh leobadin dechol, vehu zilzul leyom tob. Umittaam zeh asur legarer beyom tob hattamka sheqqorin qerey"n bemorag charutz, lepi shedderek legorero harbeh beyachad letzorek b' veg' yamim.

Abal muttar ligror haggebina bemorag charutz, lepi sheen derek ligror harbeh ella mah shehu tzarik lishato. Umikkol maqom, tzarik leshannot qetzat midderek hachol, kevan shehaya epshar ligror otah meereb yom tob velo haya tamah mepig. Vaapillu im haya tamah mepig — yesh lehachamir velaasot shinnuy meat im haya yodea meetmol sheyyitztarek ligror lemachar, mittaam shebbearnu lemala lisbara haacharona.

Abal muttar ligror kedarko bemorag charutz lechem haapuy, kevan shehachittim kebar nitchanu paam achat — shub en issur techina shayyak bahem, sheen techina achar techina, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"a. Abal mikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher shello libror perurin haggedolim qetzat mittok perurim hannitchanim vedaqqim keqemach, lepi shehen chashubim kishne minim shonim, sheasur libror min echad mittok chabero apillu beyom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"v ayyen sham, al derek shennitbaer besimman shy"t ayyen sham.

En koteshin haripot (perush shekkoteshin chittim useorim lehasir qelippatan) bemakteshet gedola, shello yaaseh kederek shehu oseh bechol, mishshum zilzul yom tob. Abal koteshin bemakteshet qetanna, shezzehu shinnuy shellahem. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bimqomot shergilin kol hashshana baakilat haripot vehen iqqar tabshilehem, ulekak regilin laasotan bemakteshet gedola, umakteshet qetanna hi shinnuy lahem. Abal beeretz yisrael vekayyotze bah mehammeqomot sheen regilin beripot, veday lahem kol hashshana bemakteshet qetanna, veen lahem shinnuy biqtanna, lekak asur lahem liktosh beyom tob ap bemakteshet qetanna.
Veakshav kevan sheen anu yodeim ezo makteshet niqret gedola veezo qetanna — yesh leesor hakkol bekol hammeqomot.

Ap al pi sheasur limdod beyom tob, mikkol maqom muttar adam limdod tebalin velitten biqdera bemidda vetzimtzum, kede shello yaqdiach tabshilo. Veakshav sheap bechol en nohagin limdod tebalin venotenin biqdera beomed haddaat, veenan chosheshin liqdichat hattabshil, lepikak ap beyom tob asurim limdod.
